inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Tock and Mira have seen it. On Day 3 the feather actively cost YY the year's first ramp shoot — its presence on his back made the head-down dig posturally unsafe (a flat back is required to keep it riding), and he chose not to commit.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY is hungry and slower today; the day cost him real food without giving real food back.
Yesterday: refused the warm-patch dig because the feather along his back required a flat spine to ride; covered the patch and walked away with no green.

Today: the brook surged brown after an upstream icejam broke; YY could not paws-out at the eddy without losing the feather, so he watched a cluster of beechnuts pass. Drank water. Noticed a fresh deer track in the new mud.
Standing thread: the feather has now cost two meals. Trade so far: one piece of information about the deer's route.

inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Day 4 cost the second meal: a paws-out dive at the brook's eddy would have unsettled the feather's ride, so YY watched a cluster of beechnuts pass instead. The feather's pattern is becoming clear — it costs YY actions whose posture would tip it. In partial trade, YY has begun reading the surge-mud for tracks; today's haul was a fresh deer print at the bend.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY is hungrier today than yesterday; the brook gave a one-time carry he could not take.
Yesterday: covered the warm patch back over and walked away from the year's first ramp shoot.

Today: the brook ran brown after an icejam broke; a cluster of soaked beechnuts spun in the eddy three squirrel-leaps from the bank and YY watched it travel away rather than tip the feather. He noticed a deer's three-toed track in the surge mud — fresh, this morning's, the size that probably broke the dam.
Standing thread: the feather is shaping his goals — secondary has shifted from posture-legibility toward reading what others leave behind.

change_summary.notable_shift: Branch goal shifts from staying-legible toward reading-tracks. The feather's cost is no longer just visibility — it is now narrowing what postures, and so what foraging, are available. YY is starting to substitute information for food.
